common_framing_suggestion.note: Use almost full native 1024px source width instead of .30 crop. Final UI framing belongs to root and is not modified here.

generation_validation.native_validation: Not performed by this asset subagent; root owns studio/native acceptance.

limitations: Face widths and faceCenter are visual estimates, not automatic measured face segmentation.
Away/side states have about430px visible facial skin width, frontal states around490px.
Independent edits preserve the shared composition closely but are not pixel-aligned animation; small hair/eyelid/neck changes remain.
Waiting and complete have a subtle near-front three-quarter/oblique eye line rather than exact symmetric front view; neutral/smile introduction endpoints are genuinely frontal.
Bottom and side garment/hair intentionally leave the frame in a shoulder-up portrait; transparency checks therefore do not require transparent bottom corners.
